messages:
maria: FYI vendor sent ETA update — rack EU-east (rack-99) scheduled to land tomorrow 03:00 UTC. Can we do warmup + smoke before handing to tenant teams?
tonY: Ack. What's the expected slot time? Need to coordinate billing handoff too.
vendor-bot: [vendor update] Rack accepted, tracking ID: VND-84219, ETA 2024-11-06T03:00Z.
maria: Target warmup window 04:00-07:00 UTC. Plan: firmware smoke, RDMA test, one end-to-end inference canary (small model). Anyone on call?
jen: I can do 04:00-06:00 UTC. I'll run the firmware patch, serial check & smoke script. Share the serials pls.
galina: @billing-ops — who owns invoice/PO for this vendor? We need invoice number to attach to the rack manifest before signoff.
maria: PO is PO-77812. @tony can you confirm you'll attach it to the manifest when PR is opened?
tony: Confirmed — I'll attach PO-77812 and the delivery manifest. Also we need a quota bump in uk-east to register 12 H100 GPUs into the Dedicated pool. Can infra request the quota increase now?
jen: Filed cloud ticket #CLD-3321 with vendor last night. Status: "pending internal review", ETA 48h. Link: https://vendor.ticket/CLD-3321
maria: If quota doesn't land in time, fallback is to register 4 nodes into demo pool and hold the rest. That keeps demos running. Anyone opposed?
galina: Works for finance, just need the invoice handoff step captured in a PR. Can someone open a 1-line PR to infra-manifests with PO + timestamp?
jen: I'll open the PR after warmup with serial list and attach `tests/power-smoke.log`. Command I'll run for warmup: `scripts/firmware_warmup.sh rack-99 --serials S1234,S1235,S1236 --rdma-check`
tony: Also reminder to tag new resources: `env:dedicated`, `region:uk-east`, `owner:oncall-infra` so billing attribution picks them up.
maria: Scheduling a 15m post-warmup sync at 07:10 UTC to confirm handoff. Please react with :thumbsup: if you're in.
billing-ops: noted — we'll process invoice attachment within 24h after the PR merges.
jen: Quick note: if we see thermal alarms during firmware patch, we'll abort and escalate to vendor for replacement.
maria: Thanks all. I'll post a short checklist in a follow-up message (firmware, rdma, canary, PR, invoice).
